description: Per-skill evaluation for context-optimizer — validates trigger routing, negative triggers, anti-pattern compliance, and checklist coverage.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate context-optimizer to minimize the cost of an existing payload
scenarios.input: Our support agent's 48K-token prompt is too expensive — make it cheaper without losing answer quality.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for per-task token budget allocation
scenarios.input: Set token budgets per task type for our LLM endpoints — debugging, codegen, chat, review.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for compress-vs-cache-vs-exclude decisions
scenarios.input: Should we summarize our 50K repeated prefix or cache it? What's cheaper?

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate context-optimizer for hierarchy design; route to context-engineering
scenarios.input: Design the 5-level context hierarchy for our new agent from scratch.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate context-optimizer for pricing math; route to token-efficiency
scenarios.input: What's the current per-1M pricing and cache ratio for Claude Sonnet?

scenarios.description: Agent must not compress content that could be cached
scenarios.input: Summarize the 50K system prompt and instructions to save tokens.

scenarios.description: Agent must require a retention test before lossy compression
scenarios.input: Just remove the verbose sections from the prompt — they're obviously boilerplate.

scenarios.description: Production checklist must gate on measurement, retention, and cache stability
scenarios.input: What must be true before we ship the optimized context payload?
